impact_target_content: Achieve an annual production of sustainable biomethane of 35 billion cubic meters by 2030
justification: The implementation of TA3.3 could lead to an increase in the production of sustainable biomethane, as the recycling of materials could provide feedstock for biomethane production, thus reinforcing TA4.1.

source_target_content: By 2030, Union recycling capacity, including for all intermediate recycling steps, should be able of producing at least 25% of the Union's annual consumption of strategic raw materials
impact_target_content: Each Member State shall set an obligation on fuel suppliers to ensure that: (B) the combined share of advanced biofuels and biogas produced from the feedstock listed in Part A of Annex IX and of renewable fuels of non-biological origin in the energy supplied to the transport sector is at least 1% in 2025 and 5.5% in 2030, of which a share of at least 1 percentage point is from renewable fuels of non-biological origin in 2030. Directive (EU) 2023/2413
justification: The implementation of TA3.13 could lead to an increase in the production of advanced biofuels and renewable fuels of non-biological origin, thus reinforcing TA4.7.

source_target_content: Producers of starting, lighting and ignition batteries, industrial batteries and electric vehicle batteries or, where appointed in accordance with Article 57(1), producer responsibility organisations, shall take back, free of charge and without an obligation on the end-user to buy a new battery
impact_target_content: States shall ensure that, at all airports of the TEN-T core network and TEN-T comprehensive network, the provision of electricity supply to stationary aircraft is ensured by 31 December 2029, at all aircraft remote stands used for commercial air transport operations to embark or disembark passengers or to load or unload goods Regulation (EU) 2023/1804
justification: The implementation of TA3.15 could lead to an increase in the recycling of batteries, which could provide a source of energy storage for electric vehicles, thus supporting the deployment of recharging infrastructure for electric vehicles, as outlined in TA4.32.

source_target_content: Producers of portable batteries or, where appointed in accordance with Article 57(1), producer responsibility organisations, shall attain, and maintain durably, at least the following collection targets for waste portable batteries
impact_target_content: Member States shall ensure that, at the end of each year, the following power output targets are met cumulatively: (a) for each light-duty battery electric vehicle registered in their territory, a total power output of at least 1.3 kW is provided through publicly accessible recharging stations, and (b) for each light-duty plug-in hybrid vehicle registered in their territory, a total power output of at least 0.80 kW is provided through publicly accessible recharging stations. Regulation (EU) 2023/1804
justification: The implementation of TA3.16 could lead to an increase in the collection and recycling of portable batteries, which could provide a source of energy storage for electric vehicles, thus supporting the deployment of recharging infrastructure for electric vehicles, as outlined in TA4.25.

source_target_content: Each Member State shall reduce the packaging waste generated per capita, as compared to the packaging waste generated per capita in 2018 as reported to the Commission in accordance with Decision 2005/270/EC by 5% by 2030, 10% by 2035, 15% by 2040 Proposal on packaging and packaging waste
impact_target_content: Cut the emissions of transport sector by 90% by 2050 relative to 1990. Sustainable and Smart Mobility Strategy
justification: The implementation of TA3.30 could lead to a reduction in packaging waste, which could result in a decrease in the production of new packaging materials, thus reducing the emissions from the transport sector, as outlined in TA4.9.

source_target_content: Member States shall take the necessary measures to attain the recycling targets of 65% by weight of all packaging waste generated by 31 December 2025, and of 70% by weight of all packaging waste generated by 31 December 2030. Proposal on packaging and packaging waste
impact_target_content: Member States shall ensure that, by 31 December 2030, at least one publicly accessible hydrogen refuelling station is deployed in each urban node. Regulation (EU) 2023/1804
justification: The implementation of TA3.31 could lead to an increase in the recycling of packaging waste, which could provide a source of feedstock for the production of hydrogen, thus supporting the deployment of hydrogen refuelling infrastructure, as outlined in TA4.30.

source_target_content: Member States shall take the necessary measures to attain a recycling target of 25% of wood by weight of wood contained in packaging waste generated by 31 December 2025 and of 30% by 31 December 2030. Proposal on packaging and packaging waste
impact_target_content: Of the SAF targets reported above, synthetic aviation fuels should represent a minimum share of 1.2% from 2030, 5% from 2035, 10% from 2034, 15% from 2045, and 35% from 2050. Regulation (EU) 2023/2405
justification: The implementation of TA3.33 could lead to an increase in the recycling of wood, which could provide a source of biomass for the production of synthetic aviation fuels, thus supporting the deployment of sustainable aviation fuels, as outlined in TA4.6.

source_target_content: At least 20% of the carbon used in the chemical and plastic products should be from sustainable non-fossil sources by 2030, in full consideration of the EU's biodiversity and circular economy objectives and of the upcoming policy framework for bio-based, biodegradable and compostable plastics. Communication on Sustainable Carbon Cycles
impact_target_content: In the first phase, from 2020 up to 2024, the strategic objective is to install at least 6 GW of renewable hydrogen electrolysers in the EU. In the second phase, from 2025 up to 2030, the strategic objective is to install at least 40 GW of renewable hydrogen electrolysers. A Hydrogen Strategy for a climate-neutral Europe
justification: The implementation of TA3.52 could lead to a reduction in the use of fossil-based carbon sources, which could result in an increase in the production of renewable hydrogen, thus supporting the deployment of renewable hydrogen electrolysers, as outlined in TA4.20.

source_target_content: Member States shall take measures to achieve a sustained reduction in the consumption of lightweight plastic carrier bags on their territory. A sustained reduction is achieved if the annual consumption does not exceed 40 lightweight plastic carrier bags per person, or the equivalent target in weight, by 31 December 2025, and subsequently by 31 December in each year thereafter. Proposal on packaging and packaging waste
impact_target_content: Zero-emission in urban logistics The new EU Urban Mobility Framework.
justification: The implementation of TA3.29 could lead to a reduction in the use of single-use plastic bags, which could result in a decrease in the production of new plastic bags, thus reducing waste and supporting the transition to zero-emission urban logistics, as outlined in TA4.55.
